notes.title: Regarding Achievements for The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today I need to announce that The Clown's Forest 2 Achievements have been deleted as I will now start using it to work on the achievements for the upcoming overhaul update of TCF2 which replaces nearly everything in the game. None of the achievements would work in this new version.

I am excited about this new version of the game, I am looking forward to seeing people experience the new story, gameplay mechanics, and puzzles.

I will have more details about The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows - Overhaul Update soon!

Have a good weekend!

notes.title: The Clown's Forest: Fear of a Survivor - ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
The Clown's Forest: Fear of a Survivor is an upcoming spin-off title set just after The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows.

You play as 17-year-old Sarah Baines as she wakes up in Hartown Amusement Park, more specifically, the House of Horrors! Sarah had just survived an indirect attack by Blitzo the Clown who had lured her to the basement of a fishing hut.

Waking up, she finds herself scared and alone, and she needs to work out how to escape the hell she has found herself in. Unfortunately for her, Chester is not too far away, twisting the house of horrors to a literal death trap. Help Sarah try and escape Hartown Park alive!

You can wishlist the game here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753650/The_Clowns_Forest_Fear_of_a_Survivor/

notes.title: Quick Patch for The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows
notes.notes:
Okay everyone so I have some really exciting news for you all!

Some of you may have seen that I have had some Steam Achievements listed on the game within the library and potentially on the store page.

Yes, I can confirm The Clown's Forest 2 has officially got achievements! So if you are an avid Achievement Collector like myself, you can go wild and try collecting all 24 Achievements in the game!

(Disclaimer: The Achievement Icons are still placeholders. I will be working with some people to get some brand-new icons for the game. So they are subject to change!) 

I do need to thank a friend of mine for helping me get these achievements working. 

Thank you everyone for playing the game and I will have more news about exciting stuff soon!

- SilentWraith
